about: How the polls job reads Wikipedia. headerMap: Wikipedia link target in a table header → our party id. untracked: header targets for lists we don't profile; their below-threshold readings are dropped, but any seats send the poll to review. publisherMap: Wikipedia link target → our pollster name (must also be on the whitelist in polls.json to merge automatically). importFrom: earliest fieldwork date the job imports; earlier tables use different party lineups and need an explicit mapping before backfill.
